idea: Count-parity fix via 2×1 dominos: replace a 1×2 block of cells of side 1/k by three squares (one of side 1/k... rather two of side 1/(2k) stacked plus one of 1/k), or 2×3 blocks by six cells' worth of mixed sizes. Tabulate every small rectangular block retiling with (Δcount, Δsum) from the exact rectangle table, then knapsack these onto disjoint regions of the k×k grid to hit even n exactly.
